issues: Home page uses <Link> with role="link" and also treats the "Explore services" and CTA "Book a consultation" elements as links; the acceptance tests expect them to be <a> links (role="link") and also a button for "Explore services" may cause test failures. Change the "Explore services" element to a <button> that navigates programmatically or style a <button> as a link to match spec.

Responsive menu does not collapse at ≤390px: static validation reports page width 410px in a 390px viewport, indicating header/nav elements exceed the viewport. Implement proper responsive CSS (e.g., max-width: 100% on containers, flex wrapping, and hide nav links behind a hamburger button using the ResponsiveMenu component).

Header navigation links are not found by the responsive test on small screens because the menu is not toggled open. Ensure the "Menu" button appears at ≤420px and clicking it makes navigation links visible and accessible with role="link".

Services page items like "Hands-on team workshops" are missing or broken up, causing the description test to fail. Ensure each service item name and its one‑sentence description are rendered contiguously within the same container (e.g., a <li> with name bolded and description following).

Header/Footer test expects a unique link named "Services"; current implementation includes duplicate links in both header and footer, causing test failures. Adjust the test expectations or redesign the navigation to avoid duplicate link names across the whole document (e.g., wrap footer links in a <nav> with aria-label="footer navigation" and use a different role or scope).
feedback: Several acceptance tests are failing: the Home page layout and link/button semantics don't match the tests, the responsive menu does not collapse correctly causing width overflow, and the Services page rendering splits service names causing duplicate text matches. Fix the component implementations and CSS to satisfy the tests and the responsive validation.
